summary: Hypersomnia is a top-down tactical shooter that combines fast-paced combat mechanics with team-based competitive elements. It is written in C++ and can be hosted independently to run multiplayer game sessions across Linux, Windows, macOS, and web browsers.
goodFor: Self-hosters and gaming communities looking to spin up a dedicated multiplayer action game server for small groups.
watchOut: The absence of tagged releases suggests that you may need to build from source or rely on bleeding-edge development commits, which can introduce instability.
deployNotes: Because the project includes Docker support, containerised deployment is straightforward, typically requiring standard port forwarding for game traffic and a reverse proxy if handling web-based clients.
